service.en: Issue a new work permit for a domestic worker
service.ar: إصدار تصريح عمل جديد لعامل مساعدة منزلية
service.ur: گھریلو ملازم کے لیے نئے ورک پرمٹ کا اجرا

about: An employer asks to bring in a new domestic worker from inside or outside the country.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. TAMM fills the form in after UAE PASS sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

fees: AED 215 for citizen, GCC, resident or diplomatic sponsors
AED 105 worker insurance, paid through a separate insurance gateway
channels: TAMM website or app (sign in with UAE PASS)
